items.author: Anadolu Agency
items.content:
Russia is taking steps to build an internet network of hundreds of low-Earth-orbit satellites to establish an alternative to US-based SpaceX’s Starlink system.
Russia’s Rassvet system is scheduled to begin service in 2027.
Russian aerospace firm Bureau 1440 launched a second batch of satellites for the Rassvet system in July. The firm deployed an undisclosed number of satellites into orbit during the latest launch, reportedly separating them from the launch vehicle and transferring them to the flight control center’s management.
The firm launched the 16 satellites from its first production batch into orbit at the end of March.
Bureau 1440 had tested satellite communications technologies, inter-satellite connectivity and ground systems via experimental missions in 2023 and 2024.
The firm is expected to launch a total of 292 satellites, including spares, by 2030, while it previously said the system’s capacity could be expanded to 924 satellites if traffic demand increases.
Rassvet is one of the key projects to reduce Moscow’s foreign dependence on communications and satellite infrastructure.
The project is expected to receive 103 billion rubles ($1.2 billion) from the federal budget and around 329 billion rubles (nearly $4 billion) from the firm’s own resources through 2030.
Moscow allocated around $45.6 million from a reserve fund in 2025 for the development of the first 16 satellites. The project’s total funding is expected to reach around $5.2 billion.
Bureau 1440’s goal is to provide low-latency, high-speed broadband internet service with low-Earth-orbit satellites, serving individual users, mobile operators, transport firms, industrial facilities and customers in regions with limited communications infrastructure.
The system aims to provide user terminals with internet speeds of up to one gigabit per second and latency of up to 70 milliseconds.
Rassvet’s satellites leverage 5G NTN communications architecture, enabling interoperability between terrestrial mobile networks and satellite systems, as well as inter-satellite laser communications terminals.
The firm previously tested a laser link at a speed of 10 gigabits per second between two satellites more than 1,000 kilometers (621.3 miles) apart. The laser communications system can transmit data via other satellites in orbit rather than transmitting directly from each satellite to a ground station.
Read More: New NASA telescope to probe dark energy, dark matter and exoplanets
The firm’s satellites also feature plasma propulsion systems and advanced power systems to adjust their positions in orbit and maintain control throughout the mission.
Rassvet is expected to be especially useful in areas where constructing fiber-optic infrastructure is difficult or expensive, such as Siberia, Russia’s Far East and the Arctic.
Other Russian telecommunications firms are also working with Bureau 1440 to integrate satellite connections into the mobile communications infrastructure.
MegaFon, one of the country’s largest telecom companies, and Bureau 1440 inked a deal to connect base stations with insufficient terrestrial connectivity to the internet via Rassvet. The initial goal is to integrate 500 base stations into the system by 2027.
Efforts are underway to expand the use of Rassvet in the transport system.
Bureau 1440 and Russian Railways are collaborating to use satellite internet on Sapsan and Lastochka high-speed trains. User terminal tests for the trains are underway.
The firm is also working with Aeroflot to provide high-speed internet on aircraft.

items.author: Our Correspondent
items.content:
A constitutional bench of the Sindh High Court (SHC) issued a written order on Tuesday in a petition seeking the formation of a joint investigation team (JIT) to probe the disappearance and death of Mir Raza Ali.
Ali, owner of dessert brand Wafflix, went missing on July 28 and his body was found in Gulistan-e-Jauhar the following day. Police initially described the death as suicide, but a subsequent post-mortem examination indicated that he had been murdered.
The development came a day after the Sindh Home Department notified the formation of a judicial commission to probe the death of the 25-year-old. Justice Umar Sial was appointed its head following his nomination by the chief justice of the SHC.
In its order, the constitutional bench raised several questions, including whether it could directly order the formation of a JIT and whether it had the authority to interfere in, alter or supervise an investigation and the submission of its report.
Read: Judicial commission formed to probe Mir Raza Ali’s death
The bench also questioned whether intervention was permissible under the Sindh Tribunals of Inquiry Ordinance, 1969, without a gazette notification.
The petitioners alleged that investigators had failed to properly secure the crime scene and raised serious concerns over the conduct of the previous investigation team. They subsequently sought the formation of a JIT comprising officers with no previous connection to the case for an independent and comprehensive probe.
The court issued notices to all parties for the next hearing and directed them to assist the bench. The next hearing has been fixed for August 31.
According to the petition, a case concerning Ali's disappearance and death was registered at Ferozabad Police Station. The petitioners alleged that the investigation was compromised because the crime scene was not secured in time and witnesses' statements were not recorded promptly.
Read More: Police piece together final hours, death of Mir Raza Ali
They also alleged that electronic devices were not properly examined and that a suicide narrative was adopted and promoted prematurely.
The petitioners claimed that significant changes were made to the medico-legal record and that the police surgeon had pointed out shortcomings in the initial post-mortem examination and recommended exhumation.
Petitioners' counsel, lawyer Jibran Nasir, submitted that a special medical board examined the body following exhumation and that its findings contradicted the initial suicide narrative.
According to the petition, the final post-mortem and chemical examination reports ruled out the possibility of suicide.
Serious allegations were also levelled against members of the previous investigation team, but no action has so far been taken against them, the petitioners claimed. They also alleged mishandling or destruction of evidence and said their statements were recorded after considerable delay.
The petitioners further claimed that the current investigation team had failed to identify any suspect and had sought additional time on August 24 to submit the challan.
They urged the court to order the formation of a JIT comprising officers who had no previous connection with the case to ensure an independent and comprehensive investigation.
Earlier, the Sindh government had requested the chief justice of the SHC to constitute a judicial commission to investigate the murder, saying that the provincial government had taken the concerns raised by Ali’s family “extremely seriously” and that a letter sent by the family to the chief minister had been received.
The commission had been constituted at the request of the provincial government, even as Ali’s family had challenged the move before the SHC and sought a JIT to probe his murder.
According to the notification, issued under the Sindh Tribunals of Inquiry Ordinance, 1969, the commission had been assigned four key terms of reference. It would determine the circumstances and motives surrounding Ali’s death, assess whether the investigation had been impartial and examine whether any police officer or other official was negligent or involved in concealing evidence.
The commission would also recommend further investigation, forensic analysis and legal action, where necessary.

items.author: Usama Anjum
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) has supported the rationalization of duties and taxes on mobile devices, saying a more balanced tax structure could help make smartphones more affordable while protecting Pakistan’s local mobile manufacturing industry.
In a response prepared for the Senate Standing Committee on Cabinet Secretariat, the PTA said it favors tax rationalization in line with the government’s broader digital transformation agenda.
The authority, however, clarified that its statutory mandate is limited to the technical evaluation of mobile devices. Matters relating to the imposition, assessment, collection, and administration of duties and taxes fall under the jurisdiction of the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR).
Despite this, the PTA said the existing taxation framework should be reviewed in a way that improves smartphone affordability for consumers without undermining local manufacturing.
Balancing Affordability With Local Manufacturing
According to the PTA, any revised tax structure should strike a balance between lower smartphone prices and the sustainability of Pakistan’s local mobile phone manufacturing sector, particularly in comparison with completely built-up (CBU) imports.
The regulator said a more rationalized taxation regime could also help discourage illegal imports and other illicit practices in the handset market.
These include International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI) tampering, which remains a concern as authorities continue efforts to curb the use of illegally imported and unregistered devices.
By reducing the price gap between legally imported or locally manufactured smartphones and devices entering through unauthorized channels, the PTA believes the government could improve affordability while strengthening compliance.
The PTA’s position was included in a briefing prepared for a meeting of the Senate Standing Committee on Cabinet Secretariat scheduled for August 21.
The committee was expected to receive briefings from the PTA and Pakistan Customs authorities on the valuation of imported mobile phones, including the revaluation of older models and rationalization of related duties and taxes.
Smartphone affordability remains a key challenge in Pakistan, where device prices can directly affect mobile broadband adoption and access to digital services.
Lower taxes could help bring more consumers into the smartphone market, particularly in lower- and middle-income segments, while supporting the government’s efforts to expand digital inclusion.
At the same time, the PTA has emphasized that any tax relief should be structured carefully so that it does not weaken local assembly or encourage a surge in CBU imports.
The regulator’s position adds support to calls for a more balanced mobile phone tax regime that lowers costs for consumers while sustaining domestic manufacturing and discouraging illegal market activity.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Google has just increased the Google One prices for cloud storage plans in three African countries. Existing subscribers in Nigeria, Egypt, and Algeria will start seeing the new prices from August 26, following a transition period announced by the company in July.
Google One Prices Increase in These Countries
The latest price adjustment also covers Pakistan and Turkey. However, the amount of the increase depends on the country, subscription plan, and local currency. This means the percentage increase seen in Nigeria does not necessarily apply to users in Egypt or Algeria.
Nigerian users face a major price increase
Google One users in Nigeria are facing some of the biggest increases in the latest adjustment. The 100GB plan now costs ₦2,950 per month, compared with the previous price of ₦1,900. That represents an increase of around 55%.
The 200GB plan has also become more expensive. Its monthly price has increased from ₦2,900 to ₦4,400, which is almost a 52% jump.
The higher price can make a noticeable difference for users who keep the subscription throughout the year. At the old monthly rate, the 200GB plan would cost ₦34,800 annually. At the new rate, the yearly cost rises to ₦52,800. This means users will pay an additional ₦18,000 over 12 months.
When will existing users pay the new rates?
Google is introducing the new prices at different times depending on how customers purchased their subscriptions.
Existing monthly subscribers who pay through Apple’s App Store started moving to the new prices on August 23. Google Play subscribers and customers with annual subscriptions purchased through Apple will begin paying the updated rates when their plans renew on or after August 26.
New customers have already been paying the higher prices since July 27.
Google Play subscribers in the affected markets who do not want to continue at the new price have until August 25 to cancel their subscription. Cancelling the plan does not immediately remove the paid storage. Users will continue to receive their Google One benefits until the end of their current billing period.
What happens after cancellation?
Google One provides additional storage for services such as Google Drive, Gmail and Google Photos. Standard Google accounts come with up to 15GB of free storage.
Users who cancel a paid plan but have more data stored than the free allowance may eventually face restrictions. Once their paid storage expires, Google warns that services such as Gmail, Drive and Photos could be affected.
Three African markets affected
Nigeria, Egypt and Algeria are among the five countries included in Google’s latest Google One price adjustment.
Google has not applied one fixed percentage increase across all markets. Prices vary based on the plan and local currency, so Nigerian users should not assume that subscribers in Egypt or Algeria will see the same percentage changes.
The latest move also marks another round of Google One price increases in Africa. Google introduced a wider price adjustment across 18 countries in February 2025. Nigeria and Egypt were included in that earlier round, while Algeria is being affected in the latest change.
Google One is becoming more than cloud storage
The price increases come as Google continues to expand Google One beyond basic cloud storage. The service is increasingly connected with Google’s AI offerings, including additional Gemini features and larger storage packages.
For existing subscribers, however, the immediate impact is straightforward. Keeping the same Google One plan will cost more when their next eligible renewal date arrives.

items.summary:
D2C brand Epigamia’s existing shareholders Verlinvest and the family of its late cofounder Rohan Mirchandani have increased their stakes in the startup through a secondary transaction valued at $20 Mn.
Sauce.vc also joined Epigamia’s cap table as part of the transaction. The deal involved the purchase of shares from existing investors and did not result in any fresh capital infusion into the startup.
DSG Consumer Partners and Deepika Padukone’s investment firm KA Enterprises were among the selling shareholders in the transaction. The selling investors sold a portion of their stakes.
Verlinvest first backed the startup in 2016 as part of its $6 Mn Series A funding round. It subsequently increased its stake through participation in multiple funding rounds.

items.author: Palak Sharma
items.content:
D2C brand Epigamia’s existing shareholders Verlinvest and the family of its late cofounder Rohan Mirchandani have increased their stakes in the startup through a secondary transaction valued at $20 Mn.
Sauce.vc also joined Epigamia’s cap table as part of the transaction. The deal involved the purchase of shares from existing investors and did not result in any fresh capital infusion into the startup.
DSG Consumer Partners and Deepika Padukone’s investment firm KA Enterprises were among the selling shareholders in the transaction. The selling investors sold a portion of their stakes.
Verlinvest first backed the startup in 2016 as part of its $6 Mn Series A funding round. It subsequently increased its stake through participation in multiple funding rounds.
“The strengthened commitment from Verlinvest, the Mirchandani family, and the new institutional commitment from Sauce is a strong endorsement of the business we have built and the opportunity ahead,” Epigamia CEO Ritesh Gauba said.
He added that the transaction would give Epigamia a stable shareholder base to support its next phase of growth.
To date, Epigamia has raised around $60 Mn from investors including Verlinvest, Danone Manifesto Ventures, DSG Consumer Partners, Padukone, among others.
Add DL funding chart
The secondary transaction comes a few months after Epigamia appointed Gauba as its CEO in May. He has more than 24 years of experience in the FMCG sector and has previously worked with companies including Mars and Britannia.
Around the same time, Epigamia elevated COO Ankur Goel to the role of cofounder. Following Mirchandani’s death in December 2024, Goel had been overseeing the startup’s operations alongside cofounder Uday Thakker and growth head Ajinkya Poundrik.
Founded in 2015 by Mirchandani, Thakker, Krishnamoorthy, and Rahul Jain, Epigamia began as a Greek yoghurt brand before expanding its portfolio to include artisanal curd, snack packs, mishti doi, and smoothies.
The startup sells its products through its website, ecommerce and quick commerce platforms, and offline retail stores. It claims to have a distribution network spanning more than 25,000 retail touchpoints across over 30 cities.
Epigamia is yet to file its financial statements for FY25. Its net loss declined almost 74% to ₹17.4 Cr in FY24 from ₹67 Cr in the previous fiscal year. Operating revenue rose 3.3% to ₹173.7 Cr from ₹168.1 Cr during the period.

Huawei jelas tidak ingin mengulang kelemahan dari flagship kompetitor yang mengandalkan cloud terlalu banyak untuk tugas-tugas AI.
Dari sisi desain, tri-fold diharapkan mendapatkan engsel yang dirancang ulang yang kemungkinan bisa mengurangi lipatan yang terlihat jelas pada generasi pertama, masalah yang sudah lama menjadi keluhan komunitas pengguna. Huawei juga mungkin beralih ke UFG glass pada layar untuk durabilitas yang lebih baik. Pilihan glass premium ini adalah tanda bahwa Huawei benar-benar serius melindungi investasi besar yang dilakukan pengguna tri-fold.
Palet warna yang diperkirakan akan tersedia antara lain Mystic Black, Auspicious Red, Crimson Purple, dan finish putih biasa. Tiga dari empat pilihan warna itu membawa nama yang cukup elegan, mencerminkan strategi pemasaran perusahaan untuk positioning produk ini sebagai sesuatu yang mewah dan premium, bukan sekadar gadget teknologi. Sementara Huawei belum mengkonfirmasi detail-detail ini secara resmi, mereka akan masuk akal sebagai upgrade terhadap model asli.
Baca juga: HUAWEI FreeClip 2 S Siap Hadir Resmi, Dirancang Kompatibel dengan Aksesori Clip-On Tambahan
Huawei HarmonyOS 7 Hadir untuk Generasi Gawai Terbaru
Generasi pertama Mate XT menampilkan layar 10,2 inci saat sepenuhnya membuka, dengan bodi yang tebal hanya 3,6mm pada titik tertipisnya, dan secara mengejutkan terjual lebih dari 400.000 unit meski harga yang sangat premium. Untuk Mate XT 2, Huawei perlu menjaga ponsel tetap tipis sambil membuat desain tiga engsel lebih tahan lama dan dapat diandalkan. Ini akan menjadi terutama penting untuk perangkat dengan layar lipat sebesar ini dan beberapa bagian yang bergerak.
Kesuksesan Mate XT bukan cuma memacu pembaruan dari sisi hardware saja. Software bisa sama pentingnya bagi pengguna. Untuk itulah HarmonyOS 7 yang secara resmi diperkenalkan pada Juni 2026 yang perlu menunjukkan cara kerja yang baik pada tri-fold phone. Perangkat seperti Mate XT 2 menempatkan kebutunan lebih besar dan kompleks pada software dibanding lipat standar. Huawei perlu menangani multiple windows, mengubah ukuran aplikasi di tiga layout layar berbeda, dan membuat beralih antara mode lipat dan buka terasa seamless dan alami.
HarmonyOS 7 sudah diketahui membawa fitur agentic AI dan desain spatial yang canggih, dan tri-fold menjadi canvas sempurna untuk menunjukkan kemampuan ini. Dengan tiga ukuran display berbeda ketika perangkat dibuka sebagian atau penuh, sistem operasi harus cerdas mengatur window dan widget agar tetap berguna dan intuitif di setiap konfigurasi. Ini adalah tingkat optimisasi software yang Huawei belum pernah coba sebelumnya di generasi pertama.
Untuk saat ini, perusahaan belum membagikan spesifikasi sheet resmi, jadi sebagian besar detail hardware Mate XT 2 masih belum dikonfirmasi secara resmi. Tapi penantian tidak lama, tanggal 7 September sudah di depan mata dan Huawei harusnya memang sudah siap menunjukkan karya terbaru mereka kepada dunia.

items.content:
Spiritual tech startup Utsav has secured ₹36 Cr ($3.8 Mn) in a Series A funding round led by Atomic Capital. Existing investors — India Quotient and Equanimity Investments — also doubled down on their erstwhile investment in the Kolkata-based startup.
The startup, which offers a community-led marketplace for faith and divinity, plans to use the fresh capital to accelerate product development, its tech stack, and fuel growth initiatives as it builds a digital layer connecting devotees, temples and rituals across India.
“Our most loyal devotees now book rituals every few days across several temples, and the messages they send us after a puja are the real measure of what we have built. This round lets us serve that devotion at scale, with trust, authenticity and the spirit of bhakti at the heart of every experience,” cofounder and CEO Sourajit Basu said.
Founded in 2021 by Basu, Ankita De and Prajata Samanta, Utsav enables works with temple priests, spiritual scholars and acharyas to offer authenticated rituals and devotional services on its platform. Currently, the startup claims that its platform fulfills 2.5 Lakh orders per month.
With the capital, Utsav App is planning to widen its services for the Indian diaspora over the next 12–24 months and scale its presence across the devotional ecosystem.
Prior to this round, the startup raised ₹6.4 Cr in January 2025, to expand its operations by onboarding additional temples and boost technology with AI features. Since then, it claims that its revenue has grown 8X.
Utsav’s latest funding comes amid an increasing uptick for the Indian spiritual tech segment. To note, Delhi NCR-based astrology platform AstroTalk became the first startup unicorn to emerge within this segment, after an ESOP buyback at a valuation of $1 Bn, earlier this month.
Besides, smaller, emerging spiritual tech platforms have also been seeing increased investor appetite in recent times. Last year, AppsForBharat raised ₹175 Cr ($20 Mn) in its Series C funding round, to expand its operations across more than 20 temple towns such as Ayodhya, Varanasi, Ujjain, and Haridwar.
Meanwhile, spiritual tech startup VAMA raised ₹22 Cr ($2.5 Mn) in its pre-Series A round to expand into new categories such as spiritual ecommerce and offline spiritual travel.

items.author: Usama Anjum
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) has stepped back from providing its Pak-ID application-based facial verification facility for mobile SIM issuance, prompting the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) and telecom operators to explore alternative arrangements for nationwide facial-recognition deployment.
According to a PTA document, NADRA had proposed in 2025 that its Pak-ID app be used for facial-recognition-based SIM verification. Following the proposal, cellular mobile operators completed a proof of concept for the system.
NADRA has now changed its position and expressed regret over making the Pak-ID facial verification facility available for SIM issuance.
Instead, the authority has proposed that cellular mobile operators deploy dedicated hardware at their own end to enable facial-verification-based services.
The proposed arrangement would also require operators to comply with NADRA’s newly enacted regulations governing requisite access to the National Data Warehouse, which were published on July 28, 2026.
“The implications of the same are under review at PTA and industry end,” the PTA document said.
PTA Reviewing Nationwide Facial Verification for SIM Sales
The development comes as the PTA examines ways to introduce facial-recognition technology at SIM issuance points across Pakistan.
The move is aimed at expanding biometric verification options beyond the existing mechanisms used for subscriber authentication and SIM registration.
However, NADRA’s decision not to provide Pak-ID-based facial verification means the PTA and telecom industry will now need to assess a different technical and operational model before any nationwide rollout can take place.
Under NADRA’s revised proposal, operators may have to invest in dedicated equipment and integrate their systems with the required identity-verification infrastructure while complying with the new data-access regulations.
The PTA and telecom industry are currently reviewing the regulatory, technical, and operational implications of the proposed framework.
Mobile App-Based Verification Also Under Evaluation
Separately, one cellular operator is exploring the possibility of offering biometric verification, including facial recognition, through its mobile application.
The proposal is intended to provide subscribers with another verification channel without relying exclusively on physical SIM issuance points.
Its technical feasibility is currently being evaluated.
If the proposal is found viable, the operator is expected to proceed with a proof of concept followed by further technical development.
The identity-verification process for SIM issuance remains a key regulatory concern in Pakistan, where authorities have repeatedly tightened biometric controls to curb the misuse of mobile connections.
For now, however, the nationwide rollout of facial-recognition-based SIM verification remains under review, with the PTA and telecom operators assessing alternatives after NADRA withdrew the proposed Pak-ID facility.

items.author: Anadolu Agency
items.content:
The US has launched what Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent described as an unprecedented economic campaign aimed at cutting Iran off from the global financial system and disrupting the revenue networks Washington says sustain Iran.
Dubbed Operation Economic Outcast, the campaign expands sanctions and secondary-sanctions risks across key sectors of Iran’s economy while targeting companies, individuals, vessels and intermediaries involved in oil revenues, military procurement, cyber operations and sanctions evasion.
In the Second World War, D-Day marked the historic beginning of a campaign with our allies to target and drive the enemy from its positions, including those in third countries. Today, in that same spirit, we are launching an economic onslaught against Iran’s financial connections… pic.twitter.com/1fLyobUucu
— Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent (@SecScottBessent) August 24, 2026
Speaking at a news conference Monday, Bessent said the initiative, directed by US President Donald Trump, represents a shift from containing Iran to attempting to fundamentally undermine its economic ability to operate internationally.
“Our objective is to sever every economic lifeline that sustains this tyrannical regime until Tehran stands alone,” Bessent said.
The Treasury chief said the US had mapped the networks and financial channels used by Iran to generate revenue and evade sanctions and warned that Washington would pursue them internationally.
Five critical sectors targeted
The new campaign expands the scope of potential secondary sanctions to five sectors that Washington considers critical to Iran’s ability to sustain its economy: digital assets, technology, gold, aviation and shipping.
In a press release on Monday, the Treasury Department said it had also sanctioned nearly 60 entities, individuals and vessels across multiple jurisdictions. The targets include networks allegedly involved in illicit nuclear and missile technology procurement, cyber operations and the generation and movement of oil revenues.
The measures are designed not only to target Iranian entities directly but also to pressure foreign companies, financial institutions, shipping operators and intermediaries that continue to conduct business with Tehran.
Bessent described the approach as a “zero-leakage” policy, saying Washington would seek to prevent Iran from finding alternative financial channels to rebuild its capabilities.
Read More: US expands sanctions in what it calls an 'economic onslaught' on Iran and its partners
“Beginning today, the actions of Treasury and other agencies will tighten the noose and block every potential source of revenue that funds the IRGC (Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps) and the evil Iranian regime,” he said.
The campaign also includes additional guidance on sanctions risks associated with shipping through the Strait of Hormuz as well as the suspension of several general licenses that had permitted certain transactions involving Iran.
Warning to Iran’s international partners
A central element of the Operation Economic Outcast is the threat of secondary sanctions against foreign actors that continue to facilitate Iran’s economic activity.
Bessent said US officials from the Treasury, State Department, and military are engaging with governments around the world and informing them that Washington expects action against activities it has identified as supporting Iran.
“We are giving everyone the opportunity to remedy bad behavior,” Bessent said, while warning that the opportunity would not remain open indefinitely.
He said every country would receive a defined timeline to shut down identified Iran-related activities and that the Treasury would act unilaterally if governments failed to comply.
“The United States expects action,” Bessent told reporters. “We do not have infinite patience here.”
“No one is above the reach of US sanctions,” Bessent said when asked about potential action against Chinese banks involved in financing Iranian oil imports.
Bessent refrained from naming specific governments or publicising timelines for action but said they are being communicated behind the scenes.
“We’re not going to name names. We’ve already seen some results, and I am confident the president (Trump), as you all know, is quite persuasive,” he said.
Oil networks, financial system in crosshairs
Iran’s petroleum trade is a major focus of the campaign. The US says Iranian oil revenues are moved through networks involving brokers, shell companies, intermediaries and vessels operating across several jurisdictions.
The Treasury said one of its targets is a network of companies and “shadow fleet” vessels operating in locations including the UAE, Hong Kong, China, Singapore, Switzerland, and Europe to transport Iranian oil and channel revenue to the IRGC-Quds Force and other Iranian elements.
The campaign also targets the financial infrastructure that Washington says enables sanctions evasion and money laundering.
“Any entity that facilitates money laundering on behalf of Iran will be removed from the US dollar system. The clock just started ticking,” Bessent said.
He also said he expected a major financial institution to be sanctioned by the end of the week, without identifying the institution.
The US says blocked persons’ property and interests in property under US jurisdiction will be frozen, while US persons will generally be prohibited from engaging in transactions involving designated entities unless authorised by the Treasury Department’s Office of Foreign Assets Control.
Iran faces ‘clear choice,’ Bessent says
Bessent framed the campaign as a choice between economic isolation and a potential return to international economic integration.
Also Read: Trump says Iran executions are a ‘humanitarian crisis of epic proportions’
“Iran now faces a very clear choice, with only two paths before them: complete global isolation and a subsistence economy or a path back to normalcy with an opportunity to rejoin the global economy,” he said.
The Treasury secretary characterised the campaign as an “economic D-Day,” invoking the Allied invasion of Nazi-occupied France during World War II to describe what he presented as the beginning of a sustained campaign against Iran’s economic networks.
The initiative comes amid a broader US-Iran confrontation and follows claims by the US administration that American military operations have severely damaged Iran’s military and nuclear infrastructure. Washington says the economic campaign is intended to prevent Tehran from rebuilding those capabilities and financing activities the US considers destabilising.
The Treasury, however, emphasised that sanctions are intended to change behaviour rather than simply punish those targeted.
“The ultimate goal of sanctions is not to punish, but to bring about a positive change in behavior,” the department said.
Bessent similarly presented reintegration into the global economy as an alternative to continued confrontation while warning governments and businesses that perpetuating economic ties with Tehran could bring them within the reach of US sanctions.

items.author: Ronggo
items.content:
Jakarta, Gizmologi – Game Science merilis trailer gameplay Black Myth: Zhong Kui pada 20 Agustus 2026 lalu. Trailer sepanjang 15 menit itu menampilkan tokoh protagonis utama sekaligus salah satu bos yang dihadapi dalam permainan. Ini adalah update pertama yang substansial sejak Game Science mengumumkan Black Myth: Zhong Kui di Gamescom Opening Night Live 2025, hampir setahun yang lalu.
Black Myth: Zhong Kui sendiri menjadi entri kedua dalam seri Black Myth yang dikembangkan Game Science, dan berawal dari inspirasi kreatif utama dari Zhong Kui dari Cina. Tidak seperti Wukong yang lalu, game ini bukan direct sequel tapi eksplorasi karakter mitologi Cina yang berbeda dengan cerita dan tujuan yang unik. Gamer bisa langsung memainkan seri ini tanpa perlu memainkan edisi Wukong terlebih dulu.
Seperti Black Myth: Wukong 2024 yang terinspirasi dari cerita Monkey King dari Journey to the West, Black Myth: Zhong Kui akan memberi pemain pandangan tentang figur lain dari mitologi Cina kuno. Zhong Kui dalam tradisi Cina dipercaya sebagai pejabat Taoist yang mengesankan, mampu menguasai 80.000 iblis (demon) dan berfungsi sebagai pemburu hantu. Game Science belum mengungkap setiap detail tentang versi mereka dari karakter ini, jadi interpretasi eksak Zhong Kui dalam game tetap menjadi salah satu misteri terbesarnya.
Ada optimisme tentang mekanisme gameplay yang lebih variatif untuk seri terbaru nanti. Harapan untuk dapat mengendalikan iblis yang berhasil ditaklukan muncul ke permukaan. Tidak seperti Wukong yang memang fokus pada kemampuan persenjataan saja.
Game Science juga sudah mengumumkan PC dan platform konsol mainstream seperti PS5, Xbox X|S masih jadi platform andalan. Sayangnya belum ada keterangan mengenai tanggal rilis resmi. Saat ini diperkirakan Black Myth: Zhong Kui akan hadir pada 2027 nanti, dengan kemungkinan lebih lama lagi.
Baca juga: FFWS SEA Fall 2026: Tim Indonesia Siapkan Strategi, Pemain Asing Jadi Opsi Baru
Black Myth: Zhong Kui Masih Dikembangkan dan Bisa Berubah
Trailer gameplay yang ditampilkan diambil in-game dari build yang sedang dikembangkan, dengan versi rilis final mungkin berbeda. Game Science juga secara eksplisit menyatakan bahwa beberapa aksi yang ditampilkan di layar bersifat “experimental” dan mungkin tidak akan ada di game final. Ini adalah penanda yang jelas bahwa footage yang dilihat pemain adalah snapshot dari proyek yang masih jauh dari sempurna. Setiap frame yang ditampilkan baru gambaran, bukan jaminan atas apa yang akan datang.
Dalam trailer tersebut tokoh utama tampaknya menyatu dengan entitas yang dipanggil untuk melawan seorang boss raksasa.Mekanik ini mengingatkan pada sistem summoning atau transformation yang mungkin akan menjadi bagian dari sistem pertarungan. Trailer juga mengakhiri dengan beberapa cuplikan cutscene dan kilasan Zhong Kui sendiri yang mengawasi sebuah kota di kejauhan, memberi sense of scale dan ekspresi visual yang besar. Boss yang terlihat diberi nama Da Bang Zhen Jun, menunjukkan bahwa Game Science sedang menyelami lore Taoist secara mendalam untuk enemy design mereka.
Game Science menggambarkan Black Myth: Zhong Kui sebagai action RPG dengan gaya bermain Soulslike yang intens, melanjutkan tipe pengalaman berbasis pertarungan yang membantu membuat Black Myth: Wukong sukses. Sifat supernatural dari cerita Zhong Kui membuka pintu ke berbagai musuh dan pertemuan mitologi yang luas. Namun detail seperti sistem pertarungan lengkap, mekanik progres, equipment, skill tree, dan sistem RPG lainnya belum semuanya dijelaskan

items.author: Gaurav Bagur
items.content:
In line with its bid to modernise its digital payments offerings, fintech major Pine Labs invested about ₹24 Cr on AI and research & development initiatives in the fiscal year FY26.
Over FY26, the fintech company invested ₹20 Cr in strengthening its AI capabilities, upgrading its technology infrastructure and automating customer-facing processes.
It spent another ₹4 Cr on enterprise-wide technologies such as model context protocol (MCP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), among other AI-based automation tools.
In its FY26 annual report, the company outlined that it successfully deployed email AI agents as well as PineOne Chat AI Agent to automate customer support, an AI-powered scheme configuration tool to streamline offer enablement and an AI Virtual Employee platform for multi-functional agentic tasks.
“The company continued to invest in AI agents, customer-facing chatbots, Model Context Protocol-enabled self-service platforms and Retrieval-Augmented Generation-powered operational intelligence solutions,” the report added.
The company claims that its investments have begun yielding results, with it reducing its software testing cycle times by more than 95%. Pine Labs further estimates that AI initiatives have now increased developer productivity by 25% and cut initial incident analysis time by 80%. This has helped autonomous AI agents shoulder the development of nearly 89% of all new code changes at the firm over the past two quarters, modifying more than 1.5 Mn lines of code.
Building AI Applications Beyond The Organisation
Beyond adopting AI for internal uses, Pine Labs also mentioned that it has launched some consumer and merchant facing AI tools, such as an autonomous agentic payments protocol, P3P, built atop of UPI.
The company described P3P as “a compliance-first architecture where buyer and seller agents discover, negotiate, and complete transactions autonomously within established regulatory guardrails.”
It also rolled out SignalIQ, an automated bank statement analyser and underwriting engine, which tracks UPI transactions to predict financial stress. The company claims that SignalIQ has processed over 50,000 loan requests within weeks of launch to deliver real-time credit intelligence for lending partners.
“We are no longer focused solely on adopting AI; we are helping shape the standards, protocols and infrastructure that will underpin the next generation of AI-native commerce,” Pine Labs said.
How Pine Labs Is Ensuring AI Safety And Security
Pine Labs has deployed AI across its cybersecurity operations, including false-positive analysis, zero-day threat alerts and automated code scanning.
Its AI agents operate within role-based permissions, with audit trails, continuous monitoring and centralised oversight through its Agentic HQ governance layer.
It has also rolled out automated vulnerability remediation and an IT general controls audit dashboard, along with an AI-based threat intelligence agent for security alerts and monitoring.
On the financial front, Pine Labs turned profitable for the full fiscal year in FY26, reporting a consolidated net profit of ₹112.5 Cr. Operating revenue rose 19% YoY to ₹2,710.6 Cr.
In Q1 FY27, net profit jumped more than 4X YoY to ₹19.6 Cr, although it fell 67% QoQ. Operating revenue grew 20% YoY and 5% QoQ to ₹736.9 Cr.
The fintech company’s platform processed 201 Cr transactions worth ₹4.2 Lakh Cr in GTV during the June quarter.
Shares of Pine Labs ended today’s trading session 3.84% higher at ₹163.50 apiece on the BSE.

items.author: Reuters
items.content:
Police in India's eastern Bihar state used water cannon and detained dozens of protesters attempting to march on the governor's residence on Tuesday, demanding the cancellation of a civil services recruitment examination over allegations of leaked test question papers and other wrongdoing.
The Bihar Public Service Commission test is a highly competitive state-level examination held to recruit officers to the state administration.
The protests have erupted over the test conducted in December 2024. More than 300,000 candidates appeared for 2,000 positions that were filled in June, after two rounds of tests and an interview, local media reported.
The state government has previously denied allegations of a widespread question paper leak, but it did order a re-examination at one centre at the time.
Visuals from news agency ANI showed hundreds of protesters in state capital Patna breaking through police barricades before water was sprayed from a cannon to push them back.
Visuals also showed protesters being hauled into a police bus that was driven away from the spot.
Read More: Info ministry: Asif's Pakistan-India video is AI-generated
"The protest is now peaceful, and most of the demands have been met by the government," senior police officer K.S. Anupam told Reuters.
Education Minister Mithilesh Tiwari also said the government had addressed students' demands, without giving more details, and added the door for dialogue remained "wide open".
India has seen a rise in demonstrations over wrongdoing in tests since the weeks-long Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)-led youth protests forced the federal education minister's resignation in July.
Similar protests in the neighbouring state of Jharkhand triggered the cancellation of civil service examinations there.
The CJP has announced a peaceful march in New Delhi next month to protest against what it says is the federal government's failure to fulfil some promises made at the time, including withdrawal of police cases against protesters.

items.author: Ronggo
items.content:
Jakarta, Gizmologi – Tiga wakil esports Indonesia di Free Fire World Series Southeast Asia (FFWS SEA) yakni RRQ Kazu, Bigetron by Vitality, dan ONIC berhasil mengamankan posisi 12 besar Fase Pertama babak Knockout 2026 Fall. Hasil positif ini membuat ketiganya berhak mengawali Fase Kedua pada hari pertama pekan ketiga untuk berebut tiket Grand Finals lebih awal. Peningkatan performa dominan para wakil tanah air di pekan kedua ini membuka peluang besar untuk mengunci tiket ke partai puncak lebih cepat.
Sementara itu, EVOS Divine dan MBR Omega terpaksa memulai Fase Kedua FFWS SEA dari hari kedua pekan ketiga setelah masing-masing mengakhiri Fase Pertama di peringkat ke-13 dan ke-14. Sang juara Esports World Cup: Free Fire 2025, EVOS Divine, menutup Fase Pertama dengan 266 poin dan hanya terpaut satu angka di belakang batas Top 12. Kendati harus tampil dari hari kedua, kedua tim tersebut tetap mengantongi kans besar untuk merebut tiket Grand Finals melalui raihan poin optimal pada matchday mereka.
RRQ Kazu tampil sebagai penggerak utama kebangkitan tim Indonesia dengan mencatatkan performa gemilang pada pekan kedua FFWS SEA yang berlangsung 21-23 Agustus 2026. Skuad ini berhasil menjadi Team of the Day pada hari pertama setelah memborong 111 poin, 2 Booyah, serta 73 eliminasi. Konsistensi tersebut mengantarkan RRQ Kazu melonjak ke posisi ketiga klasemen akhir Fase Pertama dengan total 396 poin dari 24 pertandingan.
“Di minggu pertama, fokus RRQ Kazu memang untuk menganalisis pola permainan tim-tim dari setiap negara. Setelah mendapatkan data yang cukup, kami menerapkan strategi di pekan kedua untuk bisa memberikan perlawanan. Saya juga melihat tim-tim Indonesia lainnya berkembang. Mereka terlihat semakin memahami META yang tepat untuk dieksekusi pada pekan kedua ini,” ujar Pelatih RRQ Kazu, Adi Gustiawan (Coach Adyy).
Baca juga: FFWS SEA Fall 2026: Tim Indonesia Siapkan Strategi, Pemain Asing Jadi Opsi Baru
Dominasi Tim Indonesia dan Skema Tiket Grand Finals FFWS SEA
Bigetron by Vitality turut menjaga stabilitas permainan hingga sukses mengunci peringkat keenam klasemen akhir FFWS SEA dengan koleksi 336 poin. Tim berjuluk Robot Merah tersebut menorehkan 2 Booyah, 211 eliminasi, serta 125 placement poin sepanjang babak penyisihan. Sementara itu, ONIC melengkapi tiga perwakilan Indonesia di jajaran Top 12 setelah mengakhiri Fase Pertama di posisi ke-11 dengan raihan 275 poin.
MBR Omega yang menduduki urutan ke-14 mengumpulkan 251 poin serta berhasil mencatatkan 2 Booyah pada babak pertama. Kejutan juga datang dari tim VAMOS asal Malaysia yang tampil sangat dominan di hari kedua FFWS SEA usai memainkan pemain asal Indonesia, Juan. Skuad asal negeri jiran tersebut secara mengejutkan sanggup membungkus 113 poin, 2 Booyah, dan 71 eliminasi dalam satu matchday.
Fase Kedua Knockout Stage dipastikan menjadi panggung penentuan bagi 18 tim peserta untuk mengamankan tiket menuju Grand Finals di Surabaya. Pada setiap matchday pekan ketiga, dua tim teratas akan langsung berhak mengantongi tiket ke partai puncak secara otomatis. Jika wakil Indonesia belum berhasil meloloskan diri di pekan ketiga, mereka masih memiliki kesempatan terakhir pada pekan keempat yang menyediakan enam tiket tersisa.
Persaingan sengit pekan ketiga FFWS SEA 2026 Fall dijadwalkan berlangsung pada 28 hingga 30 Agustus 2026 mendatang. Penggemar dapat memberikan dukungan secara langsung kepada seluruh perwakilan Indonesia demi merebut tiket partai puncak lebih awal. Seluruh keseruan jalannya pertandingan dapat disaksikan melalui tayangan live streaming di kanal resmi YouTube, Facebook, dan TikTok Free Fire Esports ID mulai pukul 17.30 WIB.

items.author: AFP
items.content:
Joe Root expressed his frustration that a winning return as England Test captain has been overshadowed by another off-field incident that saw Brydon Carse dropped for the second Test against Pakistan.
Carse has been referred to the Cricket Regulator after videos on social media appeared to show the fast bowler being led away by police in handcuffs following an incident at a nightclub in Derby on Saturday.
It is the latest in a series of alcohol-fuelled controversies that have dogged England since a disastrous tour of New Zealand and Australia at the end of last year.
White-ball captain Harry Brook was involved in an altercation with a nightclub bouncer in Wellington and videos circulated of opener Ben Duckett appearing drunk on a night out during the 4-1 Ashes series thrashing by Australia.
In June, former captain Ben Stokes and Gus Atkinson were given a written warning and stood down from the second Test against New Zealand after an incident at a London nightclub which came after they broke a curfew.
Stokes announced his shock retirement from international cricket during the third Test a few days later, paving the way for Root to return for a second spell as red-ball captain.
England thrashed Pakistan by an innings and 103 runs inside three days of his first match back in charge last week.
"If I'm being brutally honest, I'm really hacked off. I'm really disappointed that, after last week's performance, we're sat here and we're talking about something that is not related to it at all," Root told a press conference on Tuesday.
"It's not the isolated incident itself, it's the fact we continuously keep making stupid mistakes away from the game and it's detracting from what we are doing on the field."
A curfew on players going out was introduced in January following the troubled tour to Down Under.
Bigger than curfews
However, Root has said he will not impose a curfew as he does not believe it is a productive way to change the culture around the England squad.
"I still don't believe that's the way to go. It's important we create something bigger than that, it's about having something long lasting that we can be proud of," added the 35-year-old.
"Clearly we are not portraying ourselves how we want to and I think we have an opportunity to build a culture that is very strong, that we can be proud of, that is player driven and of course that isn't going to happen overnight.
"We have already had conversations as a team on what is expected from this group of players, what it means to play for England, what it takes to play for England.
"We want to create something that we can be proud of, that people who follow us can be proud of."
Carse was not selected for the first Test and has been withdrawn from the squad for the second Test, which begins at Lord's on Thursday.
Former England captain Michael Vaughan believes an example has to be made to draw a line in the sand and improve off-field behaviour going forward.
"Someone is going to have to get a punishment that sends a shiver down the whole England cricket team and right down through the programme, so that everyone knows that if you misbehave or bring any kind of bad reputation on to this team, you know what's going to come," Vaughan told the BBC.
"It's the only punishment that will really hurt players."

items.author: Pop Culture & Art
items.content:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day is closing in on Titanic at the global box office, with the Marvel blockbuster now just tens of millions of dollars away from pushing James Cameron's 1997 classic out of the top five highest-grossing films of all time.
Starring Tom Holland and Zendaya, Brand New Day has continued its extraordinary theatrical run into its fourth weekend. The film added $39 million in North America and $109 million internationally over the latest weekend, taking its worldwide total to approximately $2.22 billion.
That leaves Spider-Man: Brand New Day roughly $44 million behind Titanic, which currently sits in fifth place on the all-time global box office chart with around $2.264 billion. If the superhero film maintains its current pace, it is expected to pass Cameron's blockbuster in the coming days.
The achievement would give Brand New Day another major milestone in a record-breaking theatrical run. The film has already become the first movie in the Spider-Man franchise to cross $2 billion worldwide and reached the milestone in just three weekends, making it the second-fastest film ever to do so behind Avengers: Endgame.
Its domestic performance has been equally impressive. Brand New Day has earned more than $854.9 million in the US and Canada, putting it on course to overtake Avengers: Endgame as the second-highest-grossing domestic release ever, behind Star Wars: The Force Awakens.
The latest numbers add to a remarkable run that began with a record-breaking opening weekend. The film debuted to around $360 million domestically, surpassing Avengers: Endgame to claim the biggest domestic opening weekend in history. It also became the second-biggest global opening ever, with roughly $932 million worldwide in its first weekend.
The film has continued to break records since then. It crossed $1 billion worldwide in only six days, becoming the second-fastest movie to reach the milestone, and subsequently became the highest-grossing film of 2026.
Directed by Destin Daniel Cretton, Spider-Man: Brand New Day is Holland's fourth solo outing as Peter Parker. The film also stars Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal and Mark Ruffalo.
If Brand New Day overtakes Titanic, it will enter an increasingly exclusive section of the worldwide box office rankings. The film currently sits just behind Ne Zha 2, which has approximately $2.27 billion worldwide, meaning another major jump in the rankings could follow soon after.
The potential Titanic takedown also carries some history. When Avengers: Endgame previously overtook Cameron's film, Cameron's Lightstorm Entertainment celebrated the achievement on social media with an image of the Avengers logo sinking the Titanic. Cameron also congratulated Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige at the time.
Now, more than a quarter of a century after Titanic first became a box office phenomenon, another Marvel blockbuster is preparing to challenge its place in cinematic history. With Brand New Day still leading the North American box office in its fourth weekend, the gap is rapidly disappearing.

items.author: Web Desk
items.content:
National Assembly (NA) Speaker Sardar Ayaz Sadiq on Tuesday said Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif had taken notice of lawmakers’ poor attendance in the Lower House after some ministers raised the issue of members' non-attendance with him.
“The prime minister has taken notice of the absenteeism,” said Sadiq while talking to the media outside the NA, adding that the members and the premier were now overseeing compliance.
The speaker’s remarks came after today’s NA session was marked by a thin presence of lawmakers, prompting media inquiries about empty seats and disregard for quorum during parliamentary proceedings.
He also said that maintaining the quorum was not the responsibility of the speaker but of the government and opposition, and expressed hope that attendance would improve at the next session, expected to be held on Thursday or Friday.
Sadiq told the media that he had received a message from the government indicating that there was a realisation about the issue and that improvements would be made in future.
Read More: Govt to implement direction on Imran’s medical order after SC clarification, Sanaullah tells Senate
He urged both the treasury and opposition members to remain present during sessions, saying that leaving the seats vacant during the two to four hours allocated for debate, discussions, question hour and legislation meant that important parliamentary business remained untapped.
“Everyone suffers. It is not just the government which is unable to process the agenda of the day; the opposition too cannot go through with their agenda. It is my request [to them] that both the government and the opposition should not leave the seats vacant when the NA is in session. Use this forum as much as you can,” he said.
When asked about Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl Chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman’s stated intention to give the government a tough time over legislation, Sadiq said he viewed the development positively.
He described Fazl’s call for a “proactive approach towards legislation making” as a good initiative and expressed hope that the government would respond positively.
“It will help hold the government accountable and help it undergo reforms,” the speaker said.
On resignations submitted by Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf members from standing committees, Sadiq said he had not approved any of them, hoping that the government would continue its reform process and act on proposals put forward by the committees.
“The committees are running on requisition,” he said, stressing that their functioning would improve if opposition members attended their meetings.
On the possibility of the united opposition filing a no-confidence motion against him or the prime minister, Sadiq said it was the opposition’s democratic and political right.
“If they want to exercise this right, we will facilitate them. We will see when the time comes,” he said.
The speaker also said efforts had repeatedly been made to bridge the political divide with the opposition. He said he, PM Shehbaz, law minister and Rana Sanaullah had offered dialogue on several occasions.
Sadiq said he was now tired of repeating the offer, but would nevertheless ask the government to make another attempt to bring the opposition to the negotiating table.
“They would come if they really want to,” he concluded.

items.author: Palak Sharma
items.content:
Months after receiving the markets regulator’s nod for its IPO, Pernia’s Pop Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs has filed its red herring prospectus (RHP) for a fresh issue-only initial public offering. The company has increased the IPO size to ₹680 Cr, a ₹20 Cr increase from the initially proposed IPO size.
The IPO will open for subscription on Monday (August 31) and close on Wednesday (September 2). Anchor bidding will take place on August 28 (Friday).
The IPO comprises only a fresh issue of shares worth up to ₹680 Cr, with no offer for sale component.
Pernia’s parent filed its draft IPO papers with SEBI in September 2025 and got the regulator’s approval to proceed with the IPO in January. Since then, it raised ₹162 Cr debt across multiple tranches.
A large chunk of the fresh capital raised, ₹371.1 Cr to be precise, will be used to fund lease liabilities of Pernia’s Pop Up Stores’ experience center networks. The company operates 12 experience centres and 2 back-end offices across the country. It also has two experience centres abroad — in London and New York.
The company also plans to use ₹138.9 Cr to fund sales and marketing expenses till the fiscal year FY30. The remaining funds will fuel general corporate purposes.
Founded in 2015 by Abhishek Agarwal, Purple Style Labs is an omnichannel luxury fashion house that operates designer brands like Pernia’s Pop Up Studio & Shop, Wendell Rodricks, Hemant Trivedi, among others.
It has raised a private equity funding of about $78 Mn till date from investors like Harish Shah Family Office, Masaba Gupta, among others. Celebrities like Salman Khan, Shah Rukh Khan (on behalf of Gauri Khan Family Trust), Shraddha Kapoor, among others, are also investors of the company.
It houses offerings from top designers like Seema Gujral, Anushree Reddy, Amit Aggarwal, and Rohit Gandhi Rahul Khanna, spanning the wedding, occasion wear, menswear, and accessory categories.
It bought Pernia’s PoP-Up Shop (PPUS) in 2018. In FY26, PPUS average order value stood at ₹75,504.9 with around 1,109 designer brands available on the platform.
On the financial front, Purple Style Labs net loss jumped 51% YoY to ₹285.4 Cr in the fiscal ended in March 2026 from ₹188.4 Cr in FY25. Meanwhile, its revenue from operations increased almost 14% YoY to ₹557.8 Cr in the fiscal under review from ₹489.9 Cr in the same fiscal last year.

items.author: Anne Florentyna
items.content:
Wealth management startup Nexedge Capital has raised $20 Mn (₹191.4 Cr) in its maiden funding round co-led by Mirae Asset Venture Investment and Elev8 Venture Partners.
The startup, which offers bespoke financial services like investment planning, portfolio management, estate planning, to India’s HNIs, UHNIs, families and corporates, plans to utilise the fresh capital to strengthen its tech stack, expand network of senior bankers and its India footprint.
A portion of the funds will also go into building out complementary offerings such as a dedicated NRI proposition, an NBFC business, among other initiatives.
“Our maiden raise marks an important milestone in Nexedge’s journey… This capital gives us the ability to accelerate our banker onboarding, deepen distribution across the country, and offer our conflict-free Net Worth advisory to more families,” Nexedge Capital founder Anirudha Taparia said.
Launched in 2025 by ex-360 ONE Wealth executivesTaparia, Sidhartha Shaw, Vijeeta Sharma and Pankaj Walia, the wealth management and multi-family office platform claims to have crossed $3 Bn in assets under management (AUM) and over $5 Bn in assets under administration.
Over the eighteen months of its operations, the startup claims to have grown its clientele to over 1,300 families, presence across 12 locations, and grown its employee base to over 240 and banker base to 95.
This is Elev8 Venture Partners’ second major investment since it closed its maiden ₹1,400 Cr fund in September 2025. Prior to the Nexedge investment, the VC firm led investment asset servicing startup Dovetail Capital’s ₹100 Cr Series A round in July.
“India’s HNI and UHNI wealth pool is at the start of a multi-decade compounding cycle. Wealth management rewards patience, and trust is earned over market cycles, not quarters. Nexedge stands out for its structural clarity, the depth of its founding team, and its ability to build client trust at a pace few platforms in this space have matched,” Elev8’s managing partner Navin Honagudi noted.
To note, startups providing wealth management services to UHNIs is emerging as a niche segment of sorts in the Indian fintech ecosystem. Besides Dovetail Capital, Nexedge, wealth management startup CREST also came out of stealth recently and raised $3.1 Mn in a pre-seed funding round in June. Meanwhile, ex-Share.Market CEO Ujjwal Jain left PhonePe earlier this year to launch an AI platform, Atyx.AI, in the wealth management segment back in July.
The India wealth management market is scaling at a significant rate, with projections of it breaching the $436 Bn mark by 2034. items.author: Tom Jackson
items.content:
Endeavor Nigeria has announced the selection of Desmond Koney, founder and CEO of Ghanaian agri-tech startup Complete Farmer, into its network, following a multi-stage selection process culminating at Endeavor’s International Selection Panel in Athens, Greece.
Complete Farmer is an agricultural trading company connecting international commodity buyers with smallholder farmers across Ghana and Togo. The company works with more than 72,000 farmers and supplies international buyers, including Aldi and Lidl, and its operations are supported by more than 350 field agents and eight fulfillment centres responsible for aggregation, grading, quality control and export logistics.
The startup has expanded beyond agricultural trading, developing a marketplace for farm inputs and equipment and a credit product that uses farm data to help farmers access financing. CEO Koney was selected for the Endeavor network alongside 27 other entrepreneurs leading 16 companies from markets across Europe, Africa, Asia, the Middle East and the Americas.
Joining Endeavor represents an opportunity to build beyond the company and contribute to Ghana’s broader entrepreneurial ecosystem.
“As the first Ghanaian company to join the Endeavor network, I also see this as something bigger than Complete Farmer. It creates a bridge between Ghana’s entrepreneurial ecosystem and a global community of founders, investors and business leaders. With that opportunity comes a responsibility to open doors for others, share what we learn and help more Ghanaian entrepreneurs access the relationships and resources that can support their own growth,” Koney said.
Ireayomide Oladunjoye, managing director of Endeavor Nigeria, said Koney was building a Ghanaian company with a distinctly regional and global opportunity.
His journey reflects the kind of entrepreneurship we believe can create meaningful economic impact while opening up new possibilities for the people and communities it serves. Welcoming Desmond into the Endeavor network is also an important opportunity to strengthen the connections between entrepreneurs across West Africa and the broader global network,” she said.

items.author: Shrishti Bisht
items.content:
Ahmedabad-based electric motorcycle startup MATTER Motor Works has raised $25 Mn (₹240 Cr) in growth capital, anchored by its existing investors, including Helena, Capital 2B, Japan Airlines & Translink Innovation Fund, and Shakopee Mdewakanton Sioux Community (SMSC).
The startup plans to deploy the capital over the next 12 months to expand its manufacturing and supply chain capacity, increase investments in brand building and distribution, and broaden its product portfolio.
MATTER also plans to launch four electric motorcycles based on its AERA platform over the next 12–24 months. The upcoming models will target new variants and rider segments, using the startup’s in-house powertrain, battery, and software stack.
The latest round takes MATTER’s total capital raised to around ₹1,000 Cr ($104 Mn). The startup said more than ₹750 Cr ($78 Mn) of this capital has already been deployed across manufacturing, research and development, and market entry.
“This capital accelerates two things at once, the growth engine that demand has already earned, and the product roadmap it unlocks: four new motorcycles built on the platform behind India’s first geared electric motorcycle, backed by 111 granted patents,” said founder and group CEO Mohal Lalbhai.
Founded in 2019 by Lalbhai, MATTER develops EV technology spanning powertrains, battery systems, control electronics, and software. It also undertakes battery and powertrain manufacturing, as well as vehicle assembly, with support from a network of more than 150 suppliers.
Its flagship product, AERA, is positioned as India’s first geared electric motorcycle. It comes with a four-speed HyperShift manual transmission, a liquid-cooled battery and motor, and an onboard charging system compatible with a standard 5-amp household socket.
The motorcycle offers a certified range of 172 kilometres on a single charge and features a seven-inch touchscreen with navigation, music, and call integration.
The funding comes as electric vehicles increase their share of India’s two-wheeler market. E2W registrations declined 1.7% MoM to 1.91 Lakh units in July from 1.94 Lakh units in June, but surged 85% YoY from 1.03 Lakh units in July 2025. TVS Motor bucked the sequential trend with double-digit growth and retained its leadership in the segment.
The broader EV ecosystem is also expanding, with cumulative EV registrations across vehicle categories crossing 1 Cr and EV penetration exceeding 8.5% of India’s automobile market, according to road transport and highways minister Nitin Gadkari.

items.author: Ronggo
items.content:
Jakarta, Gizmologi – Nintendo secara resmi mengumumkan kenaikan harga Nintendo Switch 2 di Singapura dan Malaysia mulai 1 September 2026, dengan harga di Singapura naik sebesar S$80 dan Malaysia naik MYR270. Langkah ini bagian dari gelombang penyesuaian harga global yang juga mencakup Amerika Serikat, Kanada, Inggris, dan Eropa. Di Amerika Serikat, Nintendo Switch 2 akan naik dari US$449,99 menjadi US$499,99 mulai 1 September 2026, dengan alasan perubahan kondisi pasar jangka menengah hingga panjang.
Kenaikan harga dikaitkan dengan tekanan pasar yang sedang berlangsung akibat naiknya biaya komponen, termasuk semiconductor, memori, dan komponen lainnya yang didorong oleh permintaan hardware AI global dan tekanan rantai pasokan yang lebih luas. Ini bukan masalah perusahaan asal Mario saja, tapi industri teknologi secara keseluruhan sedang menghadapi badai sempurna antara kekhawatiran AI-driven, tarif AS baru, dan kelangkaan komponen berkelanjutan. Konsumen di seluruh dunia dipaksa menanggung beban finansial akibat tantangan ini, tidak hanya di gaming tapi di semua kategori teknologi konsumen.
Nintendo tidak secara resmi beroperasi di Malaysia dengan wilayah eShop khusus, namun negara tetap menjadi pasar yang kuat untuk perangkat konsol mereka melalui distributor regional dan penjual impor. Perubahan MSRP global biasanya berdampak pada harga Malaysia dengan cukup cepat melalui fluktuasi tukar nilai tukar, biaya impor, dan margin ritel.
Pergerakan harga di Singapura dan Asia Tenggara lainnya hampir serupa, karena Microsoft dan Sony juga telah mengumumkan penyesuaian harga untuk hardware Xbox dan PlayStation masing-masing. Semua pihak terpukul oleh badai yang sama yakni biaya produksi yang meningkat, tarif baru, dan kompetisi ketat untuk chip dan memori yang sedang digunakan industri AI secara masif.

Pasar Indonesia Belum Punya Pengumuman Resmi dari Nintendo
Harga Switch 2 terbaru di Indonesia belum mengalami banyak perubahan dari bulan sebelumnya, dengan beberapa ritel di Indonesia masih membanderol harga kisaran Rp10.299.000 tanpa diskon signifikan pada Agustus 2026.
Saat ini, Nintendo belum memberikan pengumuman resmi soal kenaikan harga untuk pasar Indonesia. Ini bisa karena beberapa alasan. Pertama, Indonesia masih merupakan pasar yang beroperasi melalui distributor tidak resmi dan saluran impor paralel, bukan operasi resmi Nintendo.
Kedua, kabar menarik datang baru saja bahwa Nintendo akan secara resmi memasuki pasar Indonesia untuk pertama kalinya dengan peluncuran Switch dan Switch 2 pada Desember 2026 melalui Salim Group, mengakhiri tahun-tahun impor informal untuk 175 juta gamer Indonesia Nintendo belum mengungkapkan harga untuk kedua konsol tersebut di pasar Indonesia, namun di pasar informal Switch 2 telah diperdagangkan sekitar Rp10.300.000 per Agustus 2026.
Dengan persiapan peluncuran resmi di Desember 2026, ada kemungkinan Nintendo akan mengumumkan harga lokal Indonesia yang sudah memperhitungkan penyesuaian global yang sedang berlangsung sekarang. Penetapan harga untuk pasar Indonesia akan menjadi momen krusial karena ini adalah pertama kalinya Nintendo beroperasi resmi di sini.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
OpenAI has introduced a fun new feature for ChatGPT that allows users to turn their personal photos into custom stickers. The feature can take images from your photo library, remove the background, and transform them into stickers that can be shared in messaging apps.
The update makes it easier to create personalized stickers without using a separate photo editing or sticker-making app. Users can also create different designs from the same photo, depending on the style they want.
How to create stickers with ChatGPT
Creating a sticker is a simple process. Users first need to open ChatGPT and go to the Images section from the sidebar. From there, they can select Stickers and upload one or more photos.
After uploading an image, ChatGPT can turn it into a sticker with a transparent background. Users can create stickers one at a time or use several photos to make a complete sticker pack.
The feature also provides several visual styles. These include 3D, hand-drawn, holographic, comic book, and anime-inspired looks. Users can select a style or simply describe the type of sticker they want ChatGPT to create.
This means a regular photo can be transformed into something that looks completely different. For example, a normal portrait can become an illustrated sticker, while a picture of a pet can be turned into a cartoon-style design.
ChatGPT Can Now Turn Your Photos Into Custom iMessage and WhatsApp Stickers
ChatGPT also gives users the ability to make changes before the sticker is finished. Users can ask the AI to add or remove elements from the image. This can be useful when a photo contains objects that should not appear in the final sticker.
Another interesting option is the ability to use a reference image. If users find a particular visual style they like, they can provide that image and ask ChatGPT to create a sticker with a similar look.
Users can also describe their preferred style using text. This gives them more flexibility and means they do not always need to find a reference image first.
Stickers can be shared on iMessage and WhatsApp
After creating the stickers, users can select the Add to Chat Apps option. ChatGPT currently provides three choices: iMessage, WhatsApp, and Save to Photos.
The iMessage option allows users to add their creations to Apple’s messaging platform. WhatsApp users can also export the stickers, although there is one restriction.
To export stickers to WhatsApp, users need to have at least three stickers ready. This requirement comes from WhatsApp and applies to apps that export sticker packs. It is not a separate limitation imposed by ChatGPT.
The ability to save stickers to Photos also gives users more control over where they use their creations. They can keep the images for later or share them through other platforms.
See Also: ChatGPT May Soon Let Users Create and Export Stickers Directly to WhatsApp
Transparent backgrounds are useful beyond stickers
The background removal feature could also be useful for other tasks. ChatGPT can create images with transparent backgrounds, which makes it easier to produce clean cutouts.
For example, users could remove the background from a product photo, object, or person and use the result in another project. This makes the feature useful even for people who are not interested in creating stickers.
Overall, the new feature adds another simple creative tool to ChatGPT. Users can now turn everyday photos into personalized stickers, customize their appearance, and quickly share them through iMessage or WhatsApp.
For people who regularly use stickers in chats, the feature could be a convenient way to create unique designs without relying on dedicated editing apps.

Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Samsung may be planning an interesting change for its next Ultra flagship. A new rumor claims that the Galaxy S27 Ultra could use a special self-healing glass coating that can repair minor scratches on its own.
According to industry observer Schrödinger, Samsung and Corning are reportedly working together on a new self-healing surface coating for the next generation of Gorilla Armor glass. The technology is said to be designed to reduce the appearance of small scratches caused by everyday use.
Galaxy S27 Ultra May Feature Self-Healing Glass – What Does it Mean
The idea could make the phone’s exterior look newer for longer. However, the technology may come with some trade-offs. The rumored coating could be less resistant to scratches than traditional tempered glass. Still, the ability to automatically recover from small marks could make it useful for smartphone users.
There are still many unknowns about the reported technology. It is not clear how long Samsung and Corning have been developing it. There is also no confirmation that working samples have been produced. The final branding for the new glass is unknown as well.
Another important question is where Samsung could use the self-healing material. The rumor does not clearly state that it will be used on the Galaxy S27 Ultra’s display. It could potentially be applied to the back panel instead.
Self-healing smartphone materials are not completely new. LG experimented with the idea years ago with the G Flex 2, which launched in 2015. Its rear panel used a special material that could gradually reduce the appearance of small scratches. However, the material had some drawbacks, including attracting fingerprints and dust.
Samsung could now bring a more advanced version of the concept to a modern flagship. If the technology works as expected, it could help the Galaxy S27 Ultra maintain a cleaner appearance over time.
See Also: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Launch Date Confirmed for August 27
Recent leaked renders suggest that Samsung may keep much of the S27 Ultra’s overall design similar to the Galaxy S26 Ultra, although a new camera design has reportedly been spotted. A self-healing surface would be a more subtle upgrade that would not be obvious from leaked images.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) has suspended the licence of Fiber 2 Home (Private) Limited for one month over its failure to submit annual audited accounts and pay annual regulatory dues for three consecutive years, warning that the licences would stand terminated if the company fails to comply within the stipulated period.
The enforcement order, issued under Section 23 of the Pakistan Telecommunication (Re-organization) Act, 1996, said the company had failed to meet mandatory regulatory obligations for the financial years ended June 30, 2023, 2024 and 2025.
The PTA said Fiber 2 Home was required under its licence conditions and applicable regulations to submit annual audited accounts, auditors’ certificates and reporting packages, besides paying annual licence fee, Research and Development Fund and Universal Service Fund contributions within 120 days of the close of each financial year.
The authority said the company was also liable to pay a late payment additional fee (LPAF) at the rate of two percent per month on outstanding regulatory dues from the due date until payment.
According to the order, PTA had repeatedly approached the company regarding its outstanding compliance obligations.
For the year ended June 30, 2023, letters were issued on September 28, 2023, followed by reminders on October 16 and November 29, 2023. The authority said Fiber 2 Home neither submitted the required financial documents nor deposited the regulatory dues.
Similarly, for 2024, PTA issued a letter on September 30, 2024, followed by reminders on November 18, 2024 and January 8, 2025. The company again failed to comply.
For the year ended June 30, 2025, PTA issued a letter on October 17, 2025 and reminders on November 25, 2025 and January 26, 2026, but the company allegedly remained non-compliant.
The authority subsequently issued a show-cause notice on March 4, 2026, requiring the company to submit the outstanding audited accounts and pay all regulatory dues, including LPAF. PTA also fixed hearings on May 14 and July 15, 2026.
However, according to the enforcement order, Fiber 2 Home neither responded to the show-cause notice nor appeared before the authority at either hearing.
PTA said the notices were served at the address provided and maintained by the licensee, but the company failed to respond. Consequently, the authority proceeded ex-parte against the licensee on the basis of the available record.
Under the order, the PTA has suspended Fiber 2 Home’s licences for one month or until submission of audited accounts for 2023, 2024 and 2025 and payment of all annual regulatory dues, including LPAF, whichever occurs earlier.
The authority warned that if the company fails to comply, its licences issued in 2012 and 2018 would stand terminated automatically upon expiry of one month from the date of issuance of the enforcement order, without any further notice.
PTA has also directed all LDI, LL, TIP and mobile licensees to immediately suspend all telecommunication facilities extended to Fiber 2 Home until further orders from the authority.
